def run_permuted_control_seed(seed):
    rng_p = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    y_tr_perm = rng_p.permutation(y_tr)
    clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=100, random_state=seed)
    clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr_perm)
    p_te = clf.predict_proba(X_te)[:, 1]
    return roc_auc_score(y_te, p_te)
